items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: So we were doing a film, “Funny Bones” which is a wonderful comedy with Jerry Lewis and Oliver Platt and Lee Evans and Leslie Caron.

ctx.x: Thank you, George. Over here we have a term called train wrecks where things just go really badly. Is there anything that pops into your head?

Oh God, not half. So we were doing a film, “Funny Bones” which is a wonderful comedy with Jerry Lewis and Oliver Platt and Lee Evans and Leslie Caron. And I had written basically an orchestral score with two percussionists. And I had in mind the sound of Weather Report for the rhythm. So I booked Alex Acuna and Michael Fisher in Los Angeles. And we couldn’t find the studio and we finally found one because we were ringing them up and saying, “Are you able to show PAL videos?” PAL videos of course were British…
